description:
What is This Part?
This the Suzuki OEM Intake Manifold Gasket for the 1.3L or 1.6L / 8 Valve Engine.
Made by SUZUKI
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Intake Manifold Gasket
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1998 1.3L/8 Valve Engines Only
Suzuki Sidekick 1989 – 1993 1.6L/8 Valve Engines Only
Geo Tracker 1989 – 1993 1.6L/8 Valve Engines Only
